plan.analysis: Inclusion is the failing class: recall 0.27, 132/179 missed, median missed size 33.6px vs 90.5px train median, low-size tertile recall only 0.19 (n=146). Round 1's 0.4-1.0 same-class pastes did not move it. Patches (recall 0.63) and scratches (0.62) misses are also small and low-contrast (median 52.9px and 41.6px vs train medians 85.1/73.3), with low-size tertile recalls 0.54/0.49. Missed inclusions look like faint thin vertical streaks and small speckle clusters; missed patches are small dark blobs; missed scratches are thin short bright lines.
plan.rationale: Round 1's larger scale ranges (0.4-1.0/0.4-0.9) produced pastes bigger than the missed defects, so all classes shift to 0.3-0.8 with prefer_small to match missed sizes (ratios ~0.37/0.62/0.57 of train medians). Inclusion gets the largest share (26) since it is far behind; its sources are the faint thin-line and small-cluster defects matching the misses (bright 287 excluded), and target_pool changes to any_class for background diversity since same_class failed last round. Patches and scratches keep 12 each (same as round 1) with small-blob and thin-line sources so the shared detector is not starved. Corrected: removed invalid scratch source 81. Totals: 50 images, within headroom and cumulative caps (inclusion 50, patches 26, scratches 24).
